Controls

Mouse
Look and aim
W A S D
Fly or walk
Space / C
Climb / descend · Space on the ground leaps
Shift
Super speed: in flight past the sound barrier and up to orbit; on foot a real super-speed run that stays on the street
1 / 2 / 3
Power level for every power (3 is maximum, the default): Mach 1 / 3 / 10+, sprint 40 / 90 / 180 m/s
Left click
Punch (hold to charge) · throw what you carry
E
Grab or set down cars, rubble, people, chunks of wall
Right click / R
Heat vision
Q
Freeze breath
X
X-ray vision
H
Super hearing: tap to toggle, or hold. The city goes quiet and cries for help, heartbeats, gunshots, alarms, fires and street help requests are heard from where they are, with markers (range 300 / 600 / 1200 m by power level)
G
Thunder clap
V
Super-speed time slow
F
Switch between flying and walking
P / N
Pause and read the Daily Planet
M / Tab
City map: click to set a waypoint
K
Mute
` or F3
Show frame rate and performance
Gamepad
Sticks fly and look · A up, B down, L3 speed · RT heat, LT freeze · RB punch, LB grab · X clap, Y x-ray · R3 hearing · D-pad up time, down fly · Start pause
